scope: Newest-first ME5 energized and named Bench Pokemon counts; artwork and true BREAK excluded
source: Exact Rainier card component text, stable IDs, primary printed rules and actual server regressions

ruleReferences.usedFor: Armarouge printed40 base plus40 per own Benched Pokemon with the required attached Energy. The Rainier English card text explicitly supplies the Fire sprite. Count hosts once, using live Basic/Special Energy provision, not physical card count or unit total.
Relicanth printed10 base plus30 per own Benched Pokemon whose current printed name includes Antique. Printed top-card names only; no unprinted Rule-Box, stage or physical card-category exclusion.

Toedscruel ex Colony Rush is printed80 plus40 per own Benched Pokemon with Grass Energy. Its attack text uses the same exact generic predicate; its Protective Mycelium Ability is not enabled by this batch, so all three cards remain UNSUPPORTED.
